title: Queens Garden and Navajo Loop
map_label: A 3D loop from Sunrise Point down Queens Garden, back up the Navajo Loop and along the rim.

stops.title: Sunrise Point
stops.alt: The hoodoos of Bryce Amphitheater seen from Sunrise Point.
stops.text: The loop starts at the rim and drops into the amphitheater by Queens Garden.

stops.title: Wall Street
stops.alt: The narrow slot of Wall Street on the Navajo Loop trail.
stops.text: The climb back out passes through Wall Street, a narrow slot between tall walls.

stops.title: Back on the rim
